scenes.caption: Fruitcats — a trading card game about fruit-flavoured cats
scenes.say: This is Fruitcats, a trading card game about fruit flavoured cats and the critters who follow them. Each player leads one Hero Cat and has nine lives. Knock out all nine of your rival's lives and you win. Let me show you a game.

scenes.caption: Pick a Hero Cat — each deck plays differently
scenes.say: You start by picking a Hero Cat. Zest Rush is fast and fierce, Orchard Guard is patient and sturdy, and Mango Tango gathers treats and then drops giants. I'll take Zest Rush, and play against the middle difficulty.

scenes.caption: Mulligan: swap any cards — you get the same number back
scenes.say: You draw six cards. The mulligan lets you shuffle away any you don't like and draw the same number back, so it costs you nothing. It just decides which six you are working with.

scenes.caption: Treats are the currency — every planted card is worth 1 Treat
scenes.say: Now the important part. Treats are the only currency in the game. You plant two cards face down into your bowl, and each one becomes exactly one Treat, whatever it cost. So you plant the two cards you want least, and keep the other four.

scenes.caption: A card costs the number in its top-left corner
scenes.say: Every card has a cost, the number in its top left corner. To play it you spend that many ready Treats. Press and hold any card to see it full size, what it costs, and what its keywords mean.

scenes.caption: Play a card — it arrives resting, unless it has Zoomies
scenes.say: Playing a card puts it in your Yard. Notice it arrives tilted and marked new. A unit that just arrived is still settling in, so it cannot attack this round: it wakes up at the start of the next one. The exception is Zoomies. About a quarter of this deck has it, and those cats arrive wide awake and can attack straight away.

scenes.caption: One action each, back and forth
scenes.say: Turns alternate one action at a time. You play a card, then your opponent acts, then you again. You never sit and watch a long turn, but you also cannot line up three attacks in a row. The round ends when you both pass.

scenes.caption: Attack a unit, or the enemy Hero Cat to knock out a Life
scenes.say: Once a unit is awake, you can attack. Send it at an enemy unit and they damage each other, using the paw for power and the heart for health. Or send it at the enemy Hero Cat: that is a hit, and they lose a life.

scenes.caption: A lost Life goes to its owner's hand — Lucky cards play free
scenes.say: Here is the twist that keeps games close. A lost life does not vanish. It goes into that player's hand, so whoever is behind gets more cards. And if it happens to be a Lucky card, they may play it immediately, for free.

scenes.caption: The Yarn Ball decides who acts first
scenes.say: The yarn ball decides who acts first each round. It passes to the other player at the end of every round, unless someone takes it deliberately, which costs them the rest of their round.

scenes.caption: Play it now at fruitcats.viamochi.com
scenes.say: That is the whole game: plant treats, play cats, attack, and take all nine lives. There is a guided tutorial built in if you want to be walked through your first match. Play it now at fruitcats dot viamochi dot com.
